key.name: place-name
key.description: The place whose weather is shown, as chosen in the settings window. Empty means no place: the module shows nothing and makes no request.

key.name: place-latitude
key.description: In degrees, rounded to two decimals (about one kilometre).

key.name: place-longitude
key.description: In degrees, rounded to two decimals (about one kilometre).

key.name: units
key.description: "auto" follows the region of the system: Fahrenheit where it is in everyday use, Celsius everywhere else.

key.name: forecast-url
key.description: The forecast endpoint of Open-Meteo, or of an instance you host yourself. Must be https; plain http is accepted for this machine only. Anything else falls back to the default.

key.name: geocoding-url
key.description: The geocoding endpoint of Open-Meteo, asked only when you search a place in the settings window. Same rules as for the forecast address.
